repeatability.scope: selected Metal full-model and six-step training development checks

baseline_feasibility.stable_update_rule: At most one prospectively selected supported stable update per framework, only with official evidence of a relevant repair; pin versions and wheel identities before testing.

pytorch.finding: The tagged MPS embedding dispatcher still calls alertNotDeterministic for embedding_dense_backward_mps and uses the atomic-add implementation. Source inspection indicates rejection in strict mode rather than a deterministic alternate implementation; this release was not executed locally.

mlx.finding: The latest stable version is the same version retained in the failed baseline diagnostic. Its scatter implementation uses atomic_update, and the short-query attention dispatch still rejects training when outputs require saved logsumexp.

limitations: Official GitHub release metadata and exact tagged source bytes were inspected; no framework was installed, upgraded, patched, or executed by this check.
The separately prepared local deterministic-gradient and attention patches are development artifacts, not standard released baselines.
QKV source, binary, or policy changes require a new freeze and matching baseline/admission evidence before any formal campaign. Historical v2 evidence remains preserved for its original identities.

reasons: The unchanged standard MPS and MLX baselines failed exact repetition at every declared width (32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024); full-v3 retains both fresh-process records.
The MLX T3 full-model and training cases at widths 256, 512, and 1024 raised runtime errors, leaving the declared baseline inventory incomplete.
The user retained the strict gate. Admission seed 20261104 remains unopened; no formal fits, checkpoint audits, qualified timing ratios, or formal accuracy claims were produced.
